notes.title: PLAY TOGETHER: PARTY GAMES IS OUT!
notes.content: [h1]- - -  ABOUT THE GAME - - -[/h1][p][b]Play Together: Party Games[/b] is a shared-screen multiplayer experience designed for [b]up to 8 players[/b], where each person uses [b]their smartphone as a controller[/b] - no extra hardware or setup required. Just scan a QR code, pick a game, and jump into the fun! [/p][p][/p][p]Online or Local, Play Together: Party Games delivers fast, accessible gameplay perfect for family gatherings, game nights, or office parties.[/p][p][/p][h1]- - - FEATURES - - -[/h1][list][*][p][b]Smartphone-controlled gameplay[/b] - No need for gamepads or downloads.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Multiple mini-games[/b] - From trivia and reaction challenges to drawing games and punchlines.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Local or online[/b] - Play together in person or connect remotely via stream or call.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Easy to start, hard to stop[/b] – Designed for quick rounds and big laughs.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]- - - TRAILER - - -[/h1][p][/p][previewyoutube="pabxUsoajfk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2][b]We have 6 minigames. Here are two of them:[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]1. [b]Knockout | [/b]Push other players off the platform using your skills and power-ups.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857835/86ba9455c0077d50c0dcbf0261d55d9d276e7ac5.png"][/img][/p][p]2. [b]AniMatch | [/b]Test your attention and reflexes – find the character on your device that matches the one on the screen.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857835/e5a7dc22b7b3129e9d317f575e2006f52fc696f2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]
